mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects expanding labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces liquidity and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity multiples, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output and business activity, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals synchronized economic expansion, which typically results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 (qoq) > 0.5% and INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) combined with high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.
